notes: An account refresh pass no longer holds the loop ~2.2 s every snapshot. After v189, each snapshot still re-picked 224 idle Claude threads between two accounts with near-equal headroom, and every moved row bumped the sessions version, so notifyMeta rebuilt the whole 3,190-row session index once per row. expectAccountsUnder (refreshAccounts and scope-pin changes) now holds the pass's meta pushes in deferredMeta, latest per session, and sends them after the writes: one index rebuild per pass. Tests: sessions-limits.test.ts (a pass that moves every thread reads the table twice and pushes each moved thread once).
